title: EXCLUSIVE: Trump AI task force leaders to meet on Thursday, vice chair says
key_facts: The leaders of the task force were set to meet on Thursday 8 Oct 2026, per vice chair Kupor (Reuters exclusive).
Jay Clayton chairs the group as Trump's AI czar; vice chairs named are Under Secretary of Defense Emil Michael, OPM Director Scott Kupor and FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson.
A full committee session is expected next week.
A charter obtained by Politico gives the task force 120 days to report on cybersecurity, civil liberties, advanced-model standards and overregulation.
Six big companies have signed voluntary safety principles with no penalty for breaking them.
A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 57% of registered voters think the administration is not taking AI risks seriously enough.
quote_evidence: On Thursday, the leaders of President Donald Trump’s Super Intelligence Task Force were set to meet, Vice Chair Scott Kupor stated.

The copy of its charter acquired by POLITICO assigns the task force a duration of 120 days to investigate issues regarding cybersecurity, civil liberties, advanced-model standards, and overregulation.
why_it_matters_hint: A new US body that will shape AI policy is starting work.
